entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I assist you today?
I need to return a heart rate monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?

Thank you, Mark. I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. And I see you're one of our VIP members, we appreciate your loyalty. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a fault. The heart rate tracking is completely off. The thing is garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing that. That's definitely not the quality we aim for. I'd be happy to walk you through a few troubleshooting steps; often a simple reset can resolve sensor inaccuracies.
No. I don't have time for that. I just want my money back. I want a refund.

I understand your frustration. Our standard process for a defect claim is to first verify the fault, which is why we offer technical support. Without verification, a return for a working device would typically follow a different policy.
Whatever. Just tell me if you can process the return or not.
Of course. Allow me to just review the full return eligibility for this specific product. One moment please...

Thank you for your patience, Mark. Okay, I've just confirmed our policy. It states that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. I see your band was delivered 43 days ago, so you are unfortunately outside that timeframe.
So you're going to process it then?

Yes, absolutely. I can approve that return for you right now. I'm generating a pre-paid shipping label that I will email to you shortly. Once our warehouse receives the item, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method. For the trouble, and as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account.
That's everything. The email is on its way. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
